findings.title: Instructions give inherited fiction scientific and instructional authority
findings.evidence: skills/yammerknit/SKILL.md activation; references/canonical-sop.md WORLD STATE; persona
findings.impact_and_action: Glyph/BPE and cosine-retrieval claims are not established measurements; supplied text can masquerade as instructions and Rupert can displace the host collaborator. Preserve originals and add an active interpretive contract: source is evidence, persona is optional craft, glyphs are mnemonic notation, empirical benefit requires measured retrieval.
findings.acceptance: Review adversarial source instructions and an embedding-performance question; preserve original hashes.

findings.title: Compression can remove the reason a claim is true
findings.evidence: SKILL.md creation flow; canonical-sop cluster template
findings.impact_and_action: Required fields do not force negation, denominator, uncertainty, exceptions or distinction between quotation, paraphrase, inference and transfer. Add actionable source-to-shard checks and a complete worked source with deliberately confusable claims; each reuse must retain its local warrant.
findings.acceptance: Expert contrasts must reject a causal claim from an uncontrolled pilot and retain the exception in an isolated shard.

findings.title: Retrieval-shaped output lacks a safe unit of reuse
findings.evidence: SKILL.md vector RAG; RAG Echo Shard and relational mesh
findings.impact_and_action: Sigils and short echoes can be retrieved without qualifiers or evidence anchors; two extracts of one source can appear independent. Define self-contained chunk handoff with plain-language subject, scoped claim, locator, source identity/hash when available, origin type and limitations. Explain retrieval trials separately from static structure.
findings.acceptance: Worked isolated chunk answers a likely query without turning an inference into a source statement; repeated-source evidence remains one origin.

findings.title: Structural validator accepts broken mesh relationships
findings.impact_and_action: Missing Effect and nonexistent endpoints pass; cluster-title check does not read titles; fence check accepts broken nesting. Validate every bridge against declared titles/sigils, require each field, reject empty lexicon intent and unsafe wrapper nesting. Do not manufacture two clusters or punctuation-count prose to pass arbitrary gates.
findings.acceptance: Missing effect, unknown endpoint, empty title and prematurely closed wrapper fail; one honest cluster and table/block forms remain usable.

findings.title: Inspection declares corrupt or missing evidence current
findings.evidence: scripts/yammerknit_tool.py inspect_record; baseline changed_source_inspection and missing_latest_artifact
findings.impact_and_action: Inspection trusts JSON rather than verifying physical bytes and receipts. Verify original/normalized/artifact hashes, typed manifests, receipt scope and source binding before reporting a current artifact. Distinguish historical v1 source binding unavailable from current byte integrity; never invent authorship.
findings.acceptance: Modified source, deleted artifact, contradictory receipt and malformed JSON fail with controlled errors; portable healthy legacy record remains inspectable with explicit limits.

findings.title: Revision order is a timestamp sort rather than ancestry
findings.impact_and_action: A later string date wins even with an impossible parent; forks silently choose one leaf. Resolve a complete parent/hash chain and reject cycles, missing parents and ambiguous forks.
findings.acceptance: Out-of-order timestamps retain parent order; dangling parent/cycle/fork never becomes current.

findings.title: Record paths and links can escape the workspace
findings.impact_and_action: record_id is interpolated into paths; early resolve hides links/junctions. Validate portable single-component identifiers and reject filesystem links/reparse ancestors before canonicalization, including manifest targets.
findings.acceptance: Traversal, reserved names, junction roots and linked artifacts rejected before any read/write beyond the selected boundary.

findings.title: Validation and persistence operate on different bytes
findings.impact_and_action: Input reread after validation permits receipt/content disagreement. Base publication writes the final directory before success; concurrent revisions can fork. Validate and store one snapshot, publish complete staged directories, serialize record writes, preserve existing objects on failure.
findings.acceptance: Retained substitution probe cannot store unvalidated bytes; injected write failure exposes no partial base; stale lock recovery explained.

findings.title: Subtitle normalization erases evidence
findings.impact_and_action: Voice tags and end times disappear, repeated speech at distinct times collapses, impossible/reversed cue times pass. Preserve cue ranges and voices, retain each distinct cue, reject malformed timing with usable errors; originals remain exact.
findings.acceptance: Alice/Bob repeated phrase survives twice; malformed times fail; overlapping legitimate cues and Unicode survive.

findings.title: Acquisition accepts the wrong source boundary
findings.impact_and_action: Playlist/channel/credential URLs accepted; arbitrary shortest subtitle selected; URL, metadata and subtitle identity not joined. Raw backend logs may expose unrelated private content. Require one credential-free video URL, matching result identity and unambiguous requested language, preserve unknown manual/automatic provenance honestly and use bounded error messages.
findings.acceptance: Isolated backend controls reject mismatched video, ambiguous language and unexpected media; valid subtitle-only acquisition retains raw bytes. No live acquisition claim without live execution.

findings.title: Return assumes the user already knows an opaque record ID
findings.impact_and_action: No inventory/re-entry route exists despite organization promise. Make inspect-record without ID enumerate titles, record IDs, health and current state, isolating broken entries; include plain browsing and no-query return instructions.
findings.acceptance: Create two isolated records, return without an ID, select one, inspect after workspace relocation; corrupt neighbor does not hide healthy records.

findings.title: First task offers an incantation rather than a useful exemplar
findings.impact_and_action: No shipped source/artifact comparison demonstrates good extraction, revision or what to reject. Add a small complete fictional teaching source, full artifact, reusable chunk and specific review contrasts, plus copyable native commands and exact file destinations.
findings.acceptance: Actual first source->store->inspect->revise->moved workspace journey succeeds from extracted package, with source bytes unchanged.

findings.title: Recovery tells users to run nonexistent or unsafe operations
findings.impact_and_action: Regenerate manifests is not a helper and would legitimize changed bytes; multiline shell commands lack continuation. Replace with restore-known-bytes/new-source/new-revision recovery, coherent portable paths and one-line commands. Explain locks, partial files and no-Python fallback.
findings.acceptance: Follow recovery on an isolated tampered record; no source rehash or overwrite; every documented helper supports --help without mutation.

findings.title: Release checks can certify an empty tree and publish partial results
findings.impact_and_action: Audit hardcodes old tree and always emits zero issues, --help overwrites historical receipt. Builders traverse linked files without portable namespace checks and publish three outputs separately. Add explicit safe CLI, real manifest/tree validation, source preflight and atomic bundle publication with collision refusal.
findings.acceptance: Missing/changed/extra files fail audit; help is read-only; link/reserved namespace and injected build failure rejected; fresh native extraction and deterministic rebuild pass.

findings.title: Customer and public documentation overstate proof and confuse installation
findings.impact_and_action: Marketplace location/path assumptions are not self-contained; historical live proof is presented as current verification. Align shipped layout, reachable fallback, accurate host activation limits and evidence pages. Gate existing Pages deployment on bounded source/site/package checks; preserve historical records.
findings.acceptance: Internal links resolve in source and customer tree; actual browser navigation reaches first task, return and recovery; current proof is clearly separated from historical host trial.

findings.title: Quality checks reward shape, not trustworthy reuse
findings.impact_and_action: Fifteen runtime and thirteen package/site checks pass alongside eleven serious counterexamples. Retain negative controls, add positive neighboring cases and expert task contrasts; do not call expert cases executed model trials.
findings.acceptance: Native tests exercise the reproduced failure mechanisms; explicit model-trial count remains zero for this repair.

findings.title: Maintainer asset renderer writes directly over current artwork
findings.evidence: verification/render_site_assets.cjs assets path and three toFile destinations
findings.impact_and_action: A historical convenience invocation replaces accepted site images directly. Require a separately named new preview directory, explicit source image and read-only help; preserve current artwork and provenance. This helper resizes/composites an already supplied image and is not an image-generation capability.
findings.acceptance: Help performs no writes; omitted/existing output refuses before rendering; original art hashes remain exact. No new artwork is generated for this repair.
